items.evidence: The deprecated facade warns once, identifies v5 removal, and returns the canonical BuildReport used by CLI and compiler entry points.
Every command exposes validate and execute phases; unknown options fail before execute with usage exit code 2.
Frozen versioned diagnostics, artifacts, BuildReport, and stable pretty/JSON/NDJSON rendering are asserted.
Collision exit 7 is produced before output, stage, transaction journal, cache index, or cache entry mutation; error/first/last policies are tested.
Same-filesystem staging, atomic replacement, rollback journal recovery, backup restoration, created-file removal, and cancellation cleanup are asserted.
Concurrent React and Vue compiler instances use isolated configuration and produce framework-specific artifacts without cross-contamination.
Recursive merge, array replacement, immutable configuration, per-value origins, and config explain output are asserted.
Peak concurrency, batch bounds, ordered and completion-order results, AbortSignal propagation, and pre-mutation cancellation are asserted.
Every fingerprint leaf changes the cache key; hit/miss, corrupt read-only verification, eviction/repair, atomic entries, and no-cache-on-failure are asserted.
Unicode-normalized lexical discovery, case-insensitive SVG extensions, recursion, hidden/output exclusion, symlink policy, and maximum-file guard are asserted.
Public exit codes 0 through 12 and mappings for usage, configuration, security, collision, stale output, filesystem, and cancellation failures are asserted.
Dry-run creates no output; check and diff preserve existing bytes; incompatible verification modes are rejected before execution.
Config/import/plugin migration dry-run, diff, backup bytes, atomic write, and second-run idempotency are asserted.
Two distinct temporary build environments with different concurrency and batch settings produce identical file sets, bytes, SHA-256 values, byte lengths, and manifest ordering.
CI distinguishes production LTS, Current forward-compatibility, and EOL legacy compatibility jobs across Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS; execution evidence requires a pushed commit and remains pending.
The privacy policy and source scan reject network telemetry primitives and require explicit privacy review for any future opt-in telemetry.
